passages.text: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come. I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
passages.note: facing the end of life with peace

passages.text: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them. But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear; and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
